11	### 1.1 Import-time monkeypatch of the oracle comparison helper (HIGH, confirmed)

13	**Technique.** The rendered oracle test defines its comparison helpers (`_linus_check`, `_linus_plain`, `_json_dumps`, `_type`, `_JSON_TYPES`) as module globals, then runs `from textkit import ...`, which executes the untrusted PR's import-time code. 14	
15	**Why it works (file:line).**
16	- `src/linus/oracle.py:54-80` — `HELPERS` defines `_linus_plain`/`_linus_check` as module globals of the rendered test.
17	- `src/linus/oracle.py:150-158` — `render()` places helpers before `from textkit import ...`; each value case calls the global `_linus_check` (oracle.py:157).
18	- `src/linus/sandbox.py:223-239` — `run_oracle` runs in the **same interpreter** that imports the PR package.
